# MIDV-2020 Source & Provenance

- **Dataset Name:** MIDV-2020: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset for Identity Documents Analysis
- **Official Publisher:** L3i Laboratory, La Rochelle University (France) & Smart Engines
- **Official Distribution Server:** `l3i-share.univ-lr.fr` (SFTP Server)
- **License:** Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5 Generic (`CC-BY-SA-2.5`)
- **Faces Source:** Generated Photos (`https://generated.photos/`)
- **Annotations Format:** VGG Image Annotator (VIA) v2.0.11
- **Local Location:** `data/external/midv-2020/`

## Official Citation
> V. V. Arlazarov, K. Bulatov, T. Chernov et al., "MIDV-2020: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset for Identity Documents Analysis," Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, 2021.
